draft_en.subject: PoE splitter (1 in / 2 out) - what we can and cannot do
draft_en.body:
Hi Ufuk,

We met at ISAF 2025 in Istanbul last October - this picks up what we discussed at the booth.

A 1-in / 2-out PoE splitter is not in our range today. The closest solution we build is a mini DIN-rail switch, 4 x Gigabit PoE+ + 1 x uplink, 48 V DC powered, model STI-054GP - $32.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity).

One question: is there external power available at the point in the field, or does the device have to be fully PoE-powered?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
